authorization: User instructed continuation under both uploaded directives. Supersedes prior research STOP only for new downstream Entry research; all upstream freezes remain immutable.

evaluator.economic: Exact imported Frozen Candidate A policy + exact imported Fixed12 runtime rebased to counterfactual OPEN. May extend beyond common window; completeness separately required. Cost 0.05pp.
evaluator.noEntry: Zero deployment net for common-paired opportunity economics, reported separately from executed-only. Missed baseline winners count in preservation denominator. Missing execution/path is unknown not zero.
evaluator.oracle: Best later executable OPEN among fixed offsets, not future LOW fill. Separate future-low upper bound.
evaluator.pathClasses: First +3 hit before any earlier negative LOW = IMMEDIATE_WINNER; earlier LOW<=-3 then strictly later +3 = DEEP_PULLBACK_THEN_WINNER; earlier negative LOW then later +3 = PULLBACK_THEN_WINNER; no +3 with terminal<0 and MAE<=-3 = CONTINUED_FAILURE; no +3 else OPPORTUNITY_EXPIRED; same first-hit bar adverse order ambiguous or incomplete = INCONCLUSIVE; CHOP_THEN_WINNER requires >=3 sign reversals of completed-close increments before first +3 without earlier negative LOW. Precedence immediate,chop,deep,pullback,failure,expired.
evaluator.primary: Complete contiguous 60-minute same-segment common window from original opportunity. Entry delay 0..30 leaves >=30 minutes. Report full 3508 coverage, do not silently drop others.
evaluator.strict30: Post-entry first 6 completed bars, only complete; secondary common-end remaining MFE/MAE and close return.
evaluator.utility: TRAIN only: common-end gross close return -0.05 +0.5*common-end MAE. Cash skip utility 0. Supervised BUY utility and WAIT option utility=max(0,later executable utility). Future max is label/oracle only, never a decision feature.

execution.cap: 30 clock minutes or current morning/afternoon boundary, whichever earlier; no lunch crossing while waiting. Missing prefix -> EXPIRE, no resurrection. Execution OPEN missing -> EXPIRE.
execution.expiry: At cap, BUY only if buy utility positive and at least wait utility; otherwise SKIP_OR_EXPIRE. No future selector invalidation inferred.
execution.immediate: Original REFERENCE_OPEN at opportunity timestamp; unknown reference expires, never substituted.
execution.independence: Opportunity generator unchanged. BUY_NOW means counterfactual entry, never actual broker fill.
execution.wait: Decision at original timestamp plus 5,10,15,20,25,30 minutes from completed prefix only; execution at that timestamp regular next-bar OPEN, no same-bar H/L features.

exposure: All 76 previously exposed; internal held-out test only, never Fresh/OOS. New test outcomes not materialized until a validation survivor is selected. No test-driven retry.

gates.cohort: Each source >=30 common cases; +3/+5 preservation>=.85, paired economic mean delta>=0. Tiny denominator does not pass.
gates.robustness: At least 3/4 chronological validation subblocks nonnegative common-opportunity net delta, top3 frequency exclusion positive net delta; source and missingness sensitivities reported. No subgroup rules.

limits: Bounded available-substrate conclusion only; failure does not establish impossibility of Entry intelligence or all PIT information. Missing full coverage pre-entry volume/market context must be explicit.

researchBudget.actions: BUY if predicted BUY>0 and BUY>=WAIT; otherwise WAIT until cap then EXPIRE. No tuned confidence margins.
researchBudget.linear: StandardScaler + Ridge alpha=10, two outputs, all permitted features; TRAIN only missing median + explicit indicators. No symbol/date ID.
researchBudget.selection: Validation all gates first; if both pass select linear. If neither passes KILL both, STOP bounded development limit without opening dev test. No next hyperparameter generation.
researchBudget.test: Only selected survivor, once; all gates plus robustness. Failure ends research, no mutation.
researchBudget.trainAblations: Fixed BASE, +PRICE, +PATH, +LEGACY_CONTEXT on first26 TRAIN sessions fit / last12 TRAIN diagnostic only. Report all; candidate uses full approved set, never choose subset from validation.
researchBudget.tree: DecisionTreeRegressor max_depth=3 min_samples_leaf=100 random_state=57, two outputs, same features; TRAIN only medians + missing indicators.

unit: 3508 emitted opportunities; INITIAL/DIP are independent counterfactual episodes, not additive funded trades. No repeated ENTER within an episode. Symbol-session duplicates across source are reported; no portfolio/no re-entry claim across independent episodes.
